tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang kun gyi// phrin las dge ba gcig bsdus pa// sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// dbang dang rjes gnang thob gyur cing*// dam tshig la gnas sgrub pa pos// mnyam par gzhag dang thun mtshams kyi// rnal 'byor gnyis la gnas par bya// de yang stan bde ba la ting nge 'dzin gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs shing phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor bla ma gtso mo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na mastā rā bha ga wa tī maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tā rā bha ga wa tī/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa'i sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum byas nas/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng da hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo/ lte ba ljang gu la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi khong du/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rang gi sems 'dres pa las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ljang gu'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du mda' yab kyis yongs su bskor ba/ phyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres nas mdzes par phub pa'i steng du rin po che dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa'i sgo'i thad so bzhir rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs dang bcas shing*/ gzhan yang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ me long dang*/ gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang*/ steng 'og tu zla ba'i gdan sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/ phyi'i grwa rnams su bdud rtsis gang zhing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad bsam par bya'o// de nas gdan dbus ma'i steng du ā li phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa'i kā li phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du tām̐ las rdo rje tām̐ gis mtshan pa/

gsum ka 'dres pa las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang*/ g.yas sngo/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dung*/ mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis lcags kyu/ ut+pa la/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' mnabs pa bsgom par bya'o// de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gnas pa'i tām̐ las/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ rnams spros pa nang gi phyogs bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhi 'og dang steng gi gdan rnams la bkod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i shar gyi 'dab ma la me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ lhor bdug spos sgrol ma sngon mo/ spos kyi dud pa 'thul ba'i spos khang 'dzin pa/ nub tu mar me sgrol ma ser mo mar me 'dzin pa/ byang du dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo dri bzang po'i chus gang ba'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lhor zhags pa ma sngon mo/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma ser mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma dmar mo rang gi ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing*/ g.yon brkyang bas bzhengs pa stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o// 'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor 'khor lo 'dzin pa la/ sgo ma ma gtogs pa rnams ni rab tu zhi zhing sgeg ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// lha zhi ba rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ sgo ma rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du so so'i sa bon bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pa las snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad sgrol ma'i lha tshogs su gyur nas 'od zer tshur 'dus pas sa bon so so la thim par bsam mo// de nas lha thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje dang*/

spyi bor sku rdo rje la sogs pas skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gi nang gi tām̐ las 'od phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu ma rnams spros pas ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya bar bsams nas so so'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ e h+ye hi sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa tī sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bya'o// de nas yang snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la sngar ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa mdzad/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ shar gyi gnyis la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ lho'i gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub kyi gnyis la 'od dpag med/ byang gi gnyis la mi bskyod pa/

'og gi la rnam par snang mdzad/ steng gi la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol la/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i me tog la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa dang*/ mchod rdzas du ma 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mchod par bsams nas/ slar yang de dag gis bstod par bsam zhing*/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas// rdo rje sgrol mar gang gyur pa// phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub ma// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod nas lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo// de nas mdun du bdud rtsi yod pa'am med kyang rung ste/ gtor ma lhar byin gyis brlabs pa des/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mchod par bsams nas myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a mṛ ta swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de/ sems mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ kye'i rdo rje dang mtshungs pa nyid do// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod pas thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra duṣ+ṭāṃ ma ma kṛ te/ dzam+bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ stam+bha ni tā rā yai swā hā/

rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ snying po dang lha thams cad pa'i sngags so// oṃ puṣ+pa tā rī swā hā/ oṃ dhū pa tā rī swā hā/ oṃ dā+e pa tā rī swā hā/ oṃ gan+dha tā rī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku shī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā shī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍī swā hā/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha ni swā hā/ zhes pa ni 'khor rnams kyi sngags so// ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o// gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/ dges pa'i rdo rje dang mtshungs la/ gtor ma'i mgron bdag gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la lha chen po brgyad dang*/ phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ nyi zla dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig bar byas la/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ in+d+ra dza ma dza la dzak+kha bhū ta bah+ni bā u rak+kha tsan+da sudz+dza ma da pap+pa ta la pa ta le aṣ+ṭa sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza dzi gha phul+la dhū ba maṃ sa piṃ ga am+ba sab+ba kādz+dza sa dā khan+ti khu ni phe ṭa gā da oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+mā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas slar yang me tog la sogs pas mchod pa snga ma ltar bstod nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// la sogs pas phrin las bcol nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshogs su bcad pa brjod la/ bzod par gsol zhing gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol la gtor ma gtong ngo*// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// kha zas yi ge gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang sgrol mar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas gang ba'i khrod du snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gsal bar dmigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/

lto bar 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi la 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs nas lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis kha hom khung du bsreg rdzas blugs pas mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe lha rnams bsdus nas/ rang sgrol ma 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag gi lus dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi rol gyi 'dod yon lngas nang gi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ yul rnams la chags pa dang sdang ba med par spyad do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba'i tshe/ lha rnams bsdus nas chos kyi sku'i ngang du nyal lo// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// ldang ba'i tshe chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis ldang ngo*// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ro// de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas rnal 'byor de dag la nan tan du byas pas ting nge 'dzin dam pa skyes pa'i tshe ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa dag la nye bar spyad pas thun mong gi dngos grub dag gis rang dang gzhan gyi yid dga' bar byas nas dbang phyug brgyad kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bir+wa pa dang ḍoṃ bi he ru ka /'jam dpal grags pa dzā lan+dha ra ba// se'u ri pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas dpal// dge ba'i 'byung gnas dpe med srung ba dang*// a wa dhū tī dārba ṇa ā tsār+ya// bla ma shes rab rin chen dpal las ni// dbang rab thob nas sgrub thabs 'phags pas sbyar// de las dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bskrun pa// de yis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab rdzogs gyur te// sgrol ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob par shog

/'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni chos thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya ba la brtul zhugs dang yon tan gyi rgyan gyis mdzes par grags pa bzang po zhes bya bas dbang bskur ba dang sgrub pa'i thabs zhus pa'i ngor chu pho spre'u'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum gyi snga dro'i cha la/ shing kun du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
